decisive_items: elevated choline peak and reduced N-acetyl aspartate signal
heterogeneously hyperintense on T2-weighted images, with heterogeneous enhancement after gadolinium administration
response.rationale: The combination of clinical presentation and imaging findings, particularly the location and appearance of the lesion on MRI, is more suggestive of medulloblastoma than pilocytic astrocytoma, with the elevated choline peak and reduced N-acetyl aspartate signal being key differentiators.

rejected.why: Absence of hemorrhage or calcification on GRE T2* sequences makes hemangioblastoma less likely
